sources.excerpt: Phenoxyethanol CAS n. 122-99-6 as preservative is regulated in Annex V/29 of the Cosmetics Regulation (EC) n. 1223/2009. According to the Cosmetics Regulation (EC) n.1223/2009 Phenoxyethanol is authorized as a preservative in cosmetic formulations at a maximum concentration of 1.0%.
2-phenoxyethanol, CAS 122-99-6, harmonised classification (Annex VI index 603-098-00-9, ATP17): Acute Tox. 4; STOT SE 3; Eye Dam. 1. Hazard statements: H302; H335; H318.
Glycerol, CAS 56-81-5: no harmonised classification in Annex VI to CLP.
Product labels on Open Beauty Facts: en:cruelty-free.
